geometry_edits.rationale: Wrap the dominant bar with a courtyard macro to create public ground logic without losing the primary gesture.
Increase the carved perimeter so the void becomes a meaningful public space rather than a shallow recess.
Orient the court to the access side to make the entry threshold legible from the street edge.
Keep the courtyard-conditioned mass as the active root so the repaired form remains one coherent dominant gesture.

graph_edits.rationale: Convert the lifted bar into a courtyard-bearing macro so the dominant mass can support a usable public void instead of reading as a sealed box.
Deepen the subtraction to create a more legible public court/entry seam along the ground edge.
Align the court opening to the programmed access side so the street edge becomes an active threshold.
Slightly amplify the court after the operator swap to ensure the void reads clearly in section and plan.

rationale: The candidate is a coherent single dominant bar-like mass across views, but it is still read as a sealed rectangular extrusion with only a token undercut and very little usable public void. The parcel response is acceptable in containment and general orientation, but the street/access edge does not yet produce a clearly legible active threshold. The silhouette is legible yet somewhat generic and only mildly sectional; it lacks the carved court/terrace logic expected for neighborhood living. Programmatically it could house some mixed-use capacity, but at this stage it feels closer to an object building than a neighborhood street building with public ground. The strongest direction is to preserve the dominant bar gesture while carving a cleaner access-side void or notch to convert the ground edge into a public threshold.

warnings: Parcel containment appears acceptable from the visible diagrams, but the form should not merely fill the parcel envelope.
The access edge needs a stronger public response; current undercut is too small to read as a threshold.
Do not introduce fragmented secondary masses; the current value is in the single dominant bar.
If revised, keep the mass continuous and add void/section consequence rather than decorative stepping.
